RUINA2-NEOW_ANGELA.title: Angela
RUINA2-NEOW_ANGELA.epithet: Director and Librarian of Her Role's Namesake
RUINA2-NEOW_ANGELA.talk.firstVisitEver.0: Greetings. I am Angela, the director and librarian of my role's namesake.
RUINA2-NEOW_ANGELA.talk.ANY.1-0r.ancient: Would you care for a boon?
RUINA2-NEOW_ANGELA.talk.ANY.2-0r.ancient: And so the script continues, never-ending.
RUINA2-NEOW_ANGELA.talk.ANY.3-0r.ancient: The librarians aren't the only people I can bring back.
RUINA2-NEOW_ANGELA.talk.ANY.4-0r.ancient: May you find your book in this place.
RUINA2-NEOW_ANGELA.talk.SILENT.0-0r.anci: A quiet guest? What a rarity.
RUINA2-NEOW_ANGELA.talk.SILENT.0-2r.anci: Let us see if your silence persists in the face of these trials.
